subject.title: fix(agents): memoize exec auto-reviewer verdicts for identical requests (#102249)

question: After the memo identity is repaired to match current main, should OpenClaw reuse completed low-risk exec reviewer verdicts for identical requests within one reviewer instance?
rationale: Even with an exact bounded key, merging intentionally changes the exec approval boundary by skipping a fresh model review for later identical requests, so the permanent policy requires owner acceptance.

options.title: Allow bounded exact-input reuse
options.body: Accept per-reviewer reuse only for completed low-risk `allow-once` decisions keyed by every current reviewer input field.

options.title: Require a fresh review every time
options.body: Keep the current behavior and decline verdict memoization despite repeated model cost.

recommendation.title: Allow bounded exact-input reuse
recommendation.body: Accept per-reviewer reuse only for completed low-risk `allow-once` decisions keyed by every current reviewer input field.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the most recent executable-binding security changes that define the request identity this cache must preserve.
